pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with soft, low-frequency pixel gradients along edges due to motion blur; spatial area is highest on the central flank and decreases towards the neck and legs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a lattice; junction nodes are visible but lack sharp definition due to motion smear; pixel thickness is relatively uniform throughout the mid-flank region.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct, localized, hyper-pigmented dark patch with textural disruption is clearly visible on the upper-posterior dorsal ridge, contrasting significantly with the surrounding pelage pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a prominent dark, irregular lesion or scab located on the dorsal ridge area.
